```yaml
name: Smoke Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v1
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Start Mastodon & Harness services
        run: |
          # Use the compose file that builds Mastodon, sidekiq, PostgreSQL, Redis, and the test harness
          docker compose -f test/smoke/mastodon/docker-compose.yml up -d

      - name: Wait for services to be healthy
        run: |
          # Wait for Mastodon API
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:4000/api/v1/instance | grep -q '"uri"'; then
              echo "Mastodon is up"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for Mastodon... ($i/30)"
            sleep 5
          done
          # Wait for the test harness health endpoint
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/_test/health | grep -q '"status":"ok"'; then
              echo "Test harness is up"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for harness... ($i/30)"
            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Run E2E orchestrator
        env:
          MASTODON_URL: http://localhost:4000
          MASTODON_USERNAME: test@example.com
          MASTODON_PASSWORD: password
          FEDIFY_URL: http://localhost:3000
        run: deno run --allow-net --allow-env test/smoke/orchestrator.ts

      - name: Tear down services
        if: always()
        run: docker compose -f test/smoke/mastodon/docker-compose.yml down
```
